title: Tangent
subtitle: Trigonometric · Ratio
summary: Ratio of sine to cosine. Poles at odd multiples of π/2.
detail:
\[ \tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x} \]

Period \(\pi\). Poles at \(x=\pi/2+n\pi\) where \(\cos x=0\). Range \((-\infty,\infty)\). Implemented with a safe fallback returning \(\pm\infty\) (not NaN) at poles.
